title: dev.hugr.corelink.breach.notification_dispatched.v1
description: Breach notification dispatch event: Privacy Officer dispatched regulatory notifications (ANPD/DPC/AG) and/or customer notifications for a personal data breach. Emitted post-dispatch per RB-BREACH-NOTIF §4.1. R2 Object Lock 7y retention (INV-AUDIT-APPEND-ONLY §3.6 L116). Emit behavior: dispatch priority over audit (regulatory SLA priority per WI-S11-006 §9.3 DD audit failure trade-off). Retry-safe via breach_id idempotency anchor.

subject.description: breach:<breach_id> — canonical subject for breach events

breach_id.description: ULID assigned at incident declaration — idempotency anchor for retry.

jurisdictions_notified.description: Regulatory authorities notified. Empty array for SEV-3 (internal only).

customer_notifications_sent.description: Whether customer notifications were dispatched (3 locales mandatory for SEV-1/2).

customer_locales.description: Customer notification locales dispatched. Mandatory 3 locales for SEV-1/2 per sprint contract §10.s11.7.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of dispatch action.

retry_attempt.description: Idempotent retry counter. 0 = first emission. Incremented on re-emit post audit-failure recovery.

breach_detected_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when breach was first detected. Anchors the 72h regulatory SLA clock.

dispatch_to_notification_seconds.description: Elapsed seconds from breach_detected_at to dispatch. Observable via corelink_breach_time_to_notification_seconds histogram.
